preconditions.description: The input `msg` must be a string.

postconditions.description: If the input string `msg` is empty, the output must be an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in msg for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output `return_value` must be a character present in the input string `msg`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output `return_value` must contain no duplicate characters.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in msg for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output `return_value` must be a sequence of characters from `msg` in the order of their 'top' positions, from highest to lowest.
The output `return_value` must be a sequence of unique characters from `msg`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in msg for i in range(len(return_value))) and all(return_value[i] != return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output `return_value` must be a sequence of unique characters from `msg` in the order of their 'top' positions, from highest to lowest, where each subsequent character is one position lower than the previous.
